summary: Waterstone Financial filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose a regular quarterly cash dividend declaration of $0.17 per share by its board on June 23, 2026. The dividend is payable August 3, 2026 to holders of record July 8, 2026. This is a routine dividend announcement with no structural change, special event, or strategic implication. No special-situation categorization applies.
